$schema_note: Each item is sized to close in one session. `verification` is the only path out of `active`, and the harness runs it — never the agent. Content items stop at `awaiting_gates`; the verification gates in docs/autonomy.md decide promotion. CI re-runs every passing claim, so editing `state` by hand is detected rather than trusted.

items.behavior: The harness owns state transitions: `make harness-activate` enforces WIP=1 and the review queue limit, `make harness-verify` runs the item's command and records the outcome, and `make harness-check --reverify` re-runs every passing claim so a hand-edited state fails CI.

items.behavior: Gate G1: every factual claim in an article is matched to a quoted span in a source fetched during verification, and the span is stored. A claim that cannot be located in a document does not promote.
items.notes: Model recall is not evidence. This is the gate that replaces human fact-checking.

items.behavior: Gate G2: an independent model, in a separate context, is asked to falsify each claim against the fetched sources. Any successful falsification quarantines the item.
items.notes: Asking 'is this right' and 'show me this is wrong' have different failure rates; only the second surfaces confident errors.

items.behavior: Gates G3 and G4: a claim may not contradict any promoted claim in the corpus, and tech.version_range is checked against real release data. A contradiction quarantines both items.

The LLM judge marks each expected_answer bullet covered, partial or missing for a given answer, and agrees with a synthetic set whose coverage is known by construction. Skipped when no API key is present, so CI stays green without one.
items.notes: The other half of the evaluator: aggregation is proven, coverage judgement is not.

items.behavior: Quarantines and disputes are clustered by mechanism rather than error string, and proposals are accepted only on two-split evidence: no regression on held-in or held-out, strict improvement on at least one. Rejected candidates are archived with their evidence.
items.notes: This is the self-improvement loop itself. Needs the gates and the judge first.

review_queue_limit_note: Cap on items awaiting the gates. A backlog of ungated drafts is not progress.
